text.tspan: Remote runs in HCP Terraform, versioned modules from a private registry, passwordless OIDC to Azure.
1 make plan / apply starts a remote run in HCP Terraform; state stays remote and locked.
2 The run resolves network, storage and policy from the private registry, pinned at 1.0.0.
3 The run presents its signed OIDC token (JWT) to Microsoft Entra ID.
4 Entra checks the federated credential and returns a short-lived Azure access token.
5 The run calls Azure Resource Manager with that token to create or update zt-rg resources.
No secret exists anywhere. setup-oidc.rb wires the trust, teardown-oidc.rb reverts it.
